heading: Today
text: Becoming cloudy.  Periods of snow and rain developing southwest to northeast, more likely in the afternoon.  Accumulations a trace to 2 inches, mostly over higher elevations south. Highs in the upper 30s to low 40s.  Light winds becoming north less than 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Rain or snow likely, changing to mostly snow.  A trace to an inch in the valleys, 2 to 4 inches over the higher terrain south.  A few snow showers in northern border counties, and cloudy in Quebec.  Lows in the upper 20s to low 30s.  Winds becoming northeast, then north, less than 10 mph, except 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Cloudy through Quebec, with a few morning snow showers in northern border counties.  Snow, steadiest south of Rt. 4, tapering to a few snow or rain showers. Additional amounts of a trace to an inch, mostly over the higher terrain.  Highs in the 30s to near 40 over the higher terrain, 40 to 45 in the valleys.  Winds north less than 10 mph, except 10 to 15 mph through the Champlain Valley.
